in Physics, composition of substances, parts of organisms, from their elementary constituents, , ; opp μίξις (combination), .
in Medicine, compounding of essences and drugs, τῶν μύρων, al., cf. , .
combination of parts so as to form a whole, γενέσεις καὶ ς. ; ἡ τῶν στρωμάτων ς. , cf. , ; in plants, .
in concrete sense, a social or political combination, ; a military formation, .
agreement, treaty, , ; πὸς τὰς συνθέσις in accordance with the agreements, , (Orchom. , iv B.C.); ἐκ συνθέσεως by arrangement, , etc.; συνθέσεις περὶ γάμων.
ς. λόγωνmaking up accounts, (i A.D.); so ς. alone, εἰς σύνθεσιν τῷ βασιλεῖ (ii B.C.).
set, service (most freq. in Lat. synthesis):
collection of clothes, wardrobe, ; also, dress, gown, costume, suit, ς. τελείας λευκὰς δεκατρεῖς, γυναικείας ς. , (ii A.D.), cf. (i A.D.), (ii A.D.), , (ii A.D.), , ; synthesinam indutus, .
